foodbank team this time of year is the busiest for the foodbank. winter and the extra demands of christmas are approaching. please remember the foodbank can only accept non- perishable foods. also, they do not accept presents. leaflets are available in the church porch with full details. sadly it is often a time when stocks are at their lowest. as always thank you for your generous support. we would like to ask those who do not presently donate, to consider joining us. every little helps. thank you annual masses for down and connor deceased teachers will be celebrated: monday 9th november 2026 at 7.30pm in all saints’ church, broughshane road, ballymena. tuesday 10th november 2026 at 7.30pm in good shepherd church (holy rosary parish), ormeau rd, belfast. please forward by friday 6th november 2026 the name and school of any teacher who died during the past twelve months to rev colin grant, director of the down and connor catholic schools’ support service, 120 cliftonville road, belfast bt14 6la tele:
dctrusteeservice@downandconnor.org
light refreshments will be served afterwards in all saints’ parish centre and holy rosary parish centre. anyone unable to attend can join online at:
www.youtube.com/@allsaintsballymena/streams
for the mass in ballymena and
www.holyrosaryparishbelfast.net

for the belfast mass. trócaire need volunteers to help deliver school talks during the annual lent appeal in february & march 2027! they are particularly interested in hearing from people with public speaking experience, especially retired teachers or those who have worked with young people. volunteers will visit local schools during school hours to share stories of hope, justice, solidarity from communities around the world. the role involves approximately 1-2 short talks per week during the campaign period. full training, presentation materials and ongoing support will be provided. please contact fionnuala mcguinness on
fionnuala.mcguinness@trocaire.org

by the first week of december if you are interested! help inspire young people to become agents of change save the date! all are invited to come and hear from representatives of 6 christian churches who will consider: 'who is mary in god’s plan of salvation?' martina purdy will present on behalf of the roman catholic tradition. there also will be time for audience questions, chaired by alf mccreary (belfast telegraph, bbc news) this is an opportunity to listen and understand other perspectives. wednesday, 2 december 2026 at 7pm in corr’s corner hotel, newtownabbey. refreshments will be served. to aid in planning please rsvp to
ecumenical@downandconnor.org

or via qr code on website anniversary mass bookings to ensure smooth continuation of mass requests please call, in person, to the parish office with full details and stipend. telephone and email requests will no longer be accepted.

journey in the footsteps of venerable matt talbot the knights of st columbanus invite everyone to an evening of faith, hope and reconciliation on friday 6th november, from 4pm, in st mary star of the sea church, killyleagh. the evening includes veneration of matt talbot's relics, confessions and benediction, followed by a film screening and q&a with michael murphy at 7pm in st mary's hall. all welcome – come for the whole evening or drop in at any time. refreshments available. suggested donation £3. mass for seafarers and fishers sunday, 15 november 2026, at 11:00am at st. peter’s cathedral, belfast, to be presided over by bishop alan mcguckian, bishop of down and connor. this special mass is an opportunity to pray for seafarers, fishers and their families, remembering especially those who have lost their lives at sea. all are warmly welcome. pioneer association - mass to remember deceased members a mass to remember all deceased members of the pioneer association will take place on friday 20 november in st agnes' church, andersonstown road, belfast at 7 pm. light refreshments afterwards. all pioneers welcome. november short-term pledge the month of november offers a special opportunity to make a small sacrifice in honour of the sacred heart of jesus. we invite parishioners and friends to consider taking a short-term pledge throughout november. pioneer offering - "i promise, in honour of the sacred heart of jesus, and with the help of the blessed virgin mary, to abstain from all intoxicating substances until the end of november." please consider joining with others in prayer, sacrifice and support for those affected by addiction.
